[b][size=4]Install[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. (optional)[/size]
